title: Atomic Theme Bridge for Rollout State Transitions
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design and prototype a small, portable token bridge and component variant layer that lets rollout engineers and product teams express and animate state transitions (canary -> ramp -> GA -> fallback) without bespoke CSS. The goal is to reduce per-rollout engineering effort, ensure visual consistency across cost/dashboards/rollout rails, and bake in accessible contrast changes for state changes.
acceptance_criteria: Token bridge spec published in Figma and linked in PRD
Three canonical transition variants implemented as interactive prototypes (instant, crossfade, staged highlight)
Component token mapping table delivered for Metric Card, Rollout Rail, and Compact Ledger components
Accessibility audit passed: color contrast >= 4.5 for all primary state text and WCAG focus indicators present
Handoff checklist completed: figma-links, token JSON export, migration guide, dev test cases
decisions: Use delta tokens (token.delta.*) for transient highlight color instead of creating new color names for each rollout
Motion patterns: default to 150ms ease-in-out for token-driven state transitions; provide option for 0ms instant toggle
Prefer semantic tokens (status.success/status.warning/status.fallback) over feature-specific names to allow reuse across console surfaces
